+import SQLeanite.SQLite.JsonText
+
+namespace SQLeanite.SQLite.JsonReplace
+open JsonValid
+
+/-- jsonFunctionArgToBlob encodes ordinary TEXT as raw JSONB string bytes;
+only TEXT carrying the actual JSON subtype is parsed as JSON input. -/
+def argument (input : ScalarValue) : Except String (Array UInt8) := do
+  match input.value with
+  | .null => return #[0]
+  | .integer _ => return JsonAccess.node 3 (Text.bytes input.value)
+  | .real _ =>
+      let bytes := Text.bytes input.value
+      let bytes := if byte bytes 0 == 73 then "9e999".toUTF8.data
+        else if byte bytes 0 == 45 && byte bytes 1 == 73 then "-9e999".toUTF8.data else bytes
+      return JsonAccess.node 5 bytes
+  | .text _ | .textBytes _ =>
+      if input.subtype == 74 then
+        let value ← JsonBinary.evaluate input.value
+        let .blob bytes := value | throw "malformed JSON"
+        return bytes
+      return JsonAccess.node 10 (Text.bytes input.value)
+  | .blob bytes =>
+      unless blobLooks bytes do throw "JSON cannot hold BLOB values"
+      return bytes
+
+/-- Replacing a nested value changes only that value and its ancestor headers.
+The same in-place width preservation used by merge patch applies here. -/
+def replaceAt (input : Array UInt8) (pos : Nat) (insert : Array UInt8) :
+    Except String (Array UInt8) := do
+  let location ← JsonRemove.locate input pos (4*input.size+4) 0 0
+  let (header,size) := (payload input pos).getD (0,0)
+  let initial := JsonPatch.edit input pos (header+size) insert true
+  let mut bytes := initial.bytes
+  let mut delta := initial.delta
+  for ancestor in location.ancestors do
+    if delta != 0 then
+      let size := ((Int.ofNat ancestor.size + delta) % (2^32)).toNat
+      let replacement := JsonExtract.reservedHeader (byte input ancestor.pos % 16) size
+      let updated := JsonPatch.edit bytes ancestor.pos ancestor.header replacement false
+      bytes := updated.bytes
+      delta := delta + updated.delta
+  return bytes
+
+def changes (input : Array UInt8) : List ScalarValue → Except String (Array UInt8)
+  | [] => .ok input
+  | pathValue :: value :: rest => do
+      if Text.isNull pathValue.value then return ← changes input rest
+      let path := Text.bytes pathValue.value
+      unless byte path 0 == 36 do throw (JsonAccess.pathError path)
+      let insert ← argument value
+      let bytes ← if byte path 1 == 0 then pure (JsonPatch.edit input 0 input.size insert true).bytes
+        else do
+          let pos ← JsonAccess.select input (some pathValue.value)
+          match pos with
+          | none => pure input
+          | some pos => replaceAt input pos insert
+      changes bytes rest
+  | _ => .error "json_replace() needs an odd number of arguments"
+
+def evaluate (binary : Bool) (inputs : List ScalarValue) : Except String ScalarValue := do
+  let value :: rest := inputs | return JsonText.plain .null
+  unless inputs.length % 2 == 1 do throw "json_replace() needs an odd number of arguments"
+  let input ← JsonBinary.evaluate value.value
+  let .blob bytes := input | return JsonText.plain .null
+  let bytes ← changes bytes rest
+  if binary then return JsonText.plain (.blob bytes)
+  JsonText.render bytes
+
+end SQLeanite.SQLite.JsonReplace

+/-- IntegerAffinity invalidates subtype flags when a REAL representation is
+converted to INTEGER. Direct integer-text conversion retains those flags. -/
+def numericClearsSubtype : PhysicalCodec.Value → Bool
+  | .realBits bits =>
+      match Numeric.integerAffinity (Float.ofBits (UInt64.ofNat bits.val)) with
+      | .integer _ => true | _ => false
+  | .text text =>
+      let source := String.ofList (text.bytes.map (fun byte => Char.ofNat byte.toNat))
+      let parsed := Numeric.parsePrefix source
+      let real := Numeric.realPrefix source
+      let integer := Numeric.realToInteger real
+      let direct := !parsed.floating && (real == 0.0 ||
+        (real == Float.ofInt integer && -2251799813685248 ≤ integer && integer < 2251799813685248) ||
+        (parsed.complete && parsed.integerFits))
+      parsed.completeToNul && !direct &&
+        (match Numeric.integerAffinity real with | .integer _ => true | _ => false)
+  | _ => false
+
+def clearsSubtype (affinity : Affinity) (value : PhysicalCodec.Value) : Bool :=
+  match affinity with
+  | .integer | .numeric | .real => numericClearsSubtype value
+  | _ => false
+

+private def expectSQLiteJsonReplaceRuntime : IO Unit := do
+  for group in [sqliteJsonReplaceRuntime0,sqliteJsonReplaceRuntime150,sqliteJsonReplaceRuntime300,sqliteJsonReplaceRuntime450] do
+    for (sql, expected) in group do
+      let actual : Except String String := do
+        let (_, results) ← CoreSQL.execute Core.State.empty sql
+        let lines ← results.flatMap (·.rows) |>.mapM fun row => do
+          let values ← row.mapM fun value => do
+            let value ← CoreExpr.value value
+            pure (String.fromUTF8! (ByteArray.mk (SQLite.Text.bytes value)))
+          pure (String.intercalate "|" values ++ "\n")
+        pure (SQLite.Text.hexBytes (String.join lines).toUTF8.data)
+      let output := match actual with
+        | .ok value => value
+        | .error message => "error:" ++ SQLite.Text.hexBytes (SQLite.Diagnostic.bytes message)
+      unless output == expected do fail s!"JSON replacement runtime differs: {sql}: {output}"

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare stored raw result bytes, including bytes after NUL, and persist JSON replacement results and observe subtype erasure on storage and failures in both public Core file engines.
+
+Pinned C supplies page geometry and input JSONB/JSON text. Newly seeded data and SQL
+variants mix with fixed transaction/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/RETURNING/CTAS
+templates. Each statement is delivered on its own input line so the pinned C
+CLI honors -bail at the same boundary; the original template is also retained.
+Same-line CLI continuation is documented separately. Compare full stdout, normalized first-line error, post-statement
+C typed rows/schema shape/integrity, Lean reopen, and a subsequent independent C
+write. Preserve unchanged files when C leaves its input unchanged. Page size
+is recorded separately because the current writer may convert it to 4096.
+"""
+import argparse,hashlib,json,os,random,re,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+def digest():
+ h=hashlib.sha256()
+ for p in sorted((ROOT/'SQLeanite').rglob('*.lean'))+[ROOT/'Main.lean']:h.update(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).encode()+b'\0'+p.read_bytes())
+ return h.hexdigest()
+def literal(s):
+ data=s.encode() if isinstance(s,str) else s
+ return "CAST(X'"+data.hex()+"' AS TEXT)"
+def statement_lines(sql):
+ """Keep SQL tokens intact; put the next statement on a new CLI input line."""
+ out=[];quote=None;i=0
+ while i<len(sql):
+  char=sql[i]
+  if quote is not None:
+   out.append(char)
+   if char==quote:
+    if quote!=']' and i+1<len(sql) and sql[i+1]==quote:
+     out.append(sql[i+1]);i+=2;continue
+    quote=None
+   i+=1;continue
+  if sql.startswith('--',i):
+   end=sql.find('\n',i)
+   if end<0:out.append(sql[i:]);break
+   out.append(sql[i:end+1]);i=end+1;continue
+  if sql.startswith('/*',i):
+   end=sql.find('*/',i+2)
+   if end<0:out.append(sql[i:]);break
+   out.append(sql[i:end+2]);i=end+2;continue
+  if char in "'\"`[":quote=']' if char=='[' else char
+  out.append(char)
+  if char==';':out.append('\n')
+  i+=1
+ return ''.join(out)
